description: This file defines a deterministic, offline AI test step suggestion generator with functions for tokenization, target detection, data hint extraction, expected outcome derivation, and rationale building. It provides a public interface function 'generate_suggested_steps' for use in test automation.

methods.name: generate_suggested_steps
methods.description: Creates a 4-step test plan with rationale based on input prompt and context, without external API calls.

methods.name: _tokenize
methods.description: Deterministic lowercase tokenization on whitespace and punctuation.

methods.name: _detect_target_hint
methods.description: Determines target page or entity from context or tokens.

methods.name: _extract_data_hint
methods.description: Derives simple input data hints based on tokens.

methods.name: _derive_expected_outcome
methods.description: Generates a stable expected outcome string based on prompt content.

methods.name: _build_rationale
methods.description: Constructs a deterministic rationale string explaining the test steps.
